description: This source file defines API routes for user authentication and profile management using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for user registration, login, getting current user profile, updating user profile, and refreshing tokens. The file interacts with a database service for user data operations and uses JWT for authentication.

classes.name: TokenData
classes.description: Data structure holding authentication token details and user info.

classes.name: UserResponse
classes.description: Data model representing user profile information returned to clients.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Data model for user registration input data.

classes.name: UserUpdate
classes.description: Data model for updating user profile.

methods.name: register_user( user_data: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Registers a new user, hashes the password, creates the user in the database, and returns an access token.

methods.name: login_user( user_data: UserLogin, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns an access token.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile( current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieves the profile information of the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile( user_data: UserUpdate, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates the profile data for the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: refresh_access_token( current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Generates a new access token for the current user.

ctags.name: update_current_user_profile
ctags.signature: ( user_data: UserUpdate, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
